evidence_before_lock.failure_component: At recovery target 1.72, every one of the 3x3 neighboring failure-return and failure-BB settings passed the raw BEAR gates. The central completed-4h rule is fixed at return <= -2% and BB improvement <= 0.40.
evidence_before_lock.target_component: Single completed-bar target touches were discontinuous: only 18 of 161 events changed between targets 1.72 and 1.74, and four 2021 events accounted for +1,227.5 bps of the difference. This indicates touch sensitivity rather than a stable economic boundary.
evidence_before_lock.mechanism_change: Require a persistent BB recovery and an explicit completed-bar price state before full exit.

immutable_common.state_exit_execution: next 15m open after the persistence requirement is satisfied

candidate_grid.economic_role: The rebound is complete only when BB recovery remains above threshold for 30–60 minutes and the completed-bar price has recovered to the configured near-entry or positive state.

neighborhood.definition: Chebyshev distance <= 1 across recovery target, consecutive-bar count, and minimum-price-return ordinal axes.

selection_rule: Select only from a connected local plateau satisfying every gate. Rank by highest worst-calendar mean net bps, then expectancy retention, then drawdown improvement, then lower max-hold rate, then lower persistence complexity, then candidate key.
release_requirement: After R9 selection, lock one BULL, RANGE, and BEAR exit candidate and a complete entry+exit fingerprint before the untouched 2020 holdout is accessed.
